text: The place is clean and the service is friendly. Thank you to the doctor and assistants for taking such good care of the patients. 🙏 …

A very nice doctor took me in without an appointment. Very gentle. Friendly service and the price for a tooth extraction was 1000 baht. It's really not much. I recommend her wholeheartedly. I received painkillers and gauze to replace the tooth dressing. Thank you very much, doctor.
Dr. Chompoonuch is so kind! Teeth scaling is 900 baht. This is my second time here and the price is still the same. Thank you! 🥰🥰🥰 …
Dr. Sukit provided excellent care and attention. His skills are superb, gentle, and professional. The service fee was very reasonable.
